name: Panakam
description: Jaggery water with lemon, ginger and cardamom — offered at Rama Navami, drunk all summer.

tcm.note: Jaggery water with citrus; cooling despite the ginger.

ayurveda.note: Gur and ginger are ushna, lemon more so — heating by the classical reading.

unani.note: Thanda in practice; a temple offering made for the hot season.

histamine.note: Lemon-based, so the citrus flag applies.

nutrition.highlight: a temple offering, and a cooler
